meta.title: 个性化小餐馆为什么越来越少
meta.title_en: Why Personalized Little Restaurants Are Disappearing

scenes.context: 讲者观察到一个对消费者不太有利的现象：个性化小餐馆越来越少，新开的生鲜店与全上海门店最多的连锁品牌装修、菜品、广告牌几乎一样。
sentences: 现在个性化的小餐馆越来越少了。
Personalized little restaurants are becoming rarer.
个性化：personalized
餐馆都长得越来越像了。
Restaurants are all starting to look alike.
长得越来越像：look alike
一样的装修风格、一样的菜品、一样的广告牌。
Same decor, same dishes, same signage.
装修风格：decor
paraphrase: 个性化小餐馆减少 → 连锁同质
Mom-and-pop shops give way to uniform chains.
装修菜品广告牌 → 完全一样
Decor, dishes, and signs all look identical.
scenes.speak: Personalized little restaurants are becoming rarer. Restaurants are all starting to look alike. Same decor, same dishes, same signage.

scenes.context: 讲者解释很难回到过去找到宝藏小店的原因：中央厨房优势太明显——空间套利（市中心租金50元/㎡/天 vs 郊区4-5元）与节省时间（半成品翻炒两下就能出锅）。
sentences: 宝藏小店开在市中心 CBD，租金昂贵。
Treasure little shops sit in city-center CBDs with expensive rent.
宝藏小店：treasure little shops
市中心每平米每天租金 50 块钱，中央厨房在郊区只要 4 到 5 块。
Downtown rent is 50 yuan per square meter a day; central kitchens in suburbs pay only 4 to 5.
空间套利：spatial arbitrage
半成品拿出来锅里翻炒两下就能出锅，上菜快。
Semi-finished goods need just two stir-fry turns, so food comes fast.
翻炒两下：a couple of stir-fry turns
paraphrase: 市中心高租金 → 搬到郊区
Moving prep work to cheap suburbs saves rent.
Pre-made food cuts cooking time dramatically.
scenes.speak: Treasure little shops sit in city-center CBDs with expensive rent. Downtown rent is 50 yuan per square meter a day; central kitchens in suburbs pay only 4 to 5. Semi-finished goods need just two stir-fry turns, so food comes fast.

scenes.context: 讲者指出辩证法：任何餐馆都在产品、运营、营销三个层面竞争，享受低成本上菜快的同时，会失去差异化与客户粘性——餐馆应保留两三款特色菜。
sentences: 任何餐馆都会在产品、运营、营销三个层面竞争。
Every restaurant competes on three fronts: product, operations, and marketing.
三个层面：three fronts
享受低成本和上菜快的同时，会失去差异化与客户粘性。
Enjoying low cost and fast service, you lose differentiation and customer loyalty.
客户粘性：customer loyalty
餐馆还是应该保留两到三款招牌菜。
Restaurants should still keep two or three signature dishes.
招牌菜：signature dishes
paraphrase: 低成本上菜快 → 失去差异化
Cheap and fast comes at the cost of distinctiveness.
保留特色菜 → 增加客户粘性
Signature dishes are what keep customers coming back.
scenes.speak: Every restaurant competes on three fronts: product, operations, and marketing. Enjoying low cost and fast service, you lose differentiation and customer loyalty. Restaurants should still keep two or three signature dishes.

practice: Restaurants are all starting to look alike.
Central kitchens profit from spatial arbitrage.
Semi-finished goods mean food comes fast.
Keep two or three signature dishes for loyalty.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：The restaurant's face is the same.
✓ 地道说法：The restaurants look alike.
✕ 直译腔：The rent in the center is 50 yuan every square meter.
✓ 地道说法：Downtown rent runs 50 yuan per square meter a day.
用 per + 时间单位更自然。
✓ 地道说法：It builds customer loyalty.
✕ 直译腔：Keep two or three sign dishes.
✓ 地道说法：Keep two or three signature dishes.
shifts: 理解中央厨房的商业模式驱动力
看到差异化与客户选择的丧失
把两三款招牌菜当作粘性资产
